content.value: What is basic difference among SL, DB and DDB depreciation? A structure costs Tk 600,000 to construct. It has 25-years life with an estimated resale value of 75% of the construction cost. However, the building will be depreciated to zero over a recovery period of 30 years. Calculate the annual depreciation charge and plot book value for years 4, 10 and 25 using (i) SL and DDB depreciation (ii) What is implied salvage value for DDB?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2016
